intro.title: The Common Grounds Media Matrix
intro.text: A smooth, slide-based presentation comparing the two countries. It charts shared seafaring history, culinary crossovers and language links, and also covers family, faith, dress, crafts, architecture, music, celebrations and people.

slides.title: Differences that Make Each Special
slides.text: Alongside everything they share, each country keeps its own character. Tunisia offers Mediterranean coast, Roman ruins and the Sahara, a cuisine of harissa and couscous, and about 12 million people. Bahrain offers an island of pearls, Dilmun mounds and gleaming skylines, a cuisine of machboos and muhammar, and about 1.5 million people. The Tunisian dialect and the Bahraini dialect differ, and each country's music, dress and architecture reflect its own history.
